newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega shares leap in mid-afternoon on 6-mo results.
newsitem.headline: Sega shares leap in mid-afternoon on 6-mo results.

text.p: Shares of Sega Enterprises Ltd leapt in Monday afternoon trade as investors decided the firm's recently announced interim earnings result was not as bad as initially expected, brokers said.
At 0428 GMT, its shares added 200 yen to 4,500 yen, the fifth largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

On Friday, the major manufacturer of game equipment said its parent current profit for the six months ended September 30, 1996, was 12.76 billion yen against 11.04 billion in the same period of the previous year.
